sources.label: Steam 讨论区首页核查
sources.excerpt: 英文讨论区首页显示 15 个主题（总数 265）；仅覆盖首页。

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 XYZ STUDIO，发行商同名）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 265），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 0 篇原始来源：结果只有本作商店页与中文页、本作差评列表页（不是单条主题帖，本轮未逐条抓取）、Instagram 与 YouTube 宣传视频页、SteamDB 价格历史页，没有针对本作 AI 使用的报道。检索范围仅限工具实际返回的内容，不能据此认定没有其他公开报道。商店披露原文只有 “Generative AI tools were used to assist with some assets.” 一句，未指明素材类型，因此本条按“范围未说明”登记，八个领域一律不使用“已使用”。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。本作处于抢先体验阶段。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI tools were used to assist with some assets.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-03 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: An open-world heavy machinery excavation simulation that entered Early Access on Oct 22, 2026. The store disclosure only states that generative AI tools were used to assist with some assets, without naming which kind of asset, so all eight areas are recorded as not addressed and the scope is flagged as unspecified.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer XYZ STUDIO, self-published) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 265); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 0 raw source(s) were read, because the results were store pages for this game, its negative-review list page rather than a single thread, promotional video pages on Instagram and YouTube and a SteamDB price history page, none of which reports on this game's AI use. That describes the search range and is not proof that no other coverage exists. The disclosure text does not identify which assets are meant, so no area is recorded as used and the scope is flagged as unspecified. The finding rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The title is in Early Access.
